error_key: Could not save the panel key: {0}
error_port:
Port {0} is busy ({1}).
The Python version or another program may already be running.
already_running: Tapswitch is already running — see its icon in the tray.
confirm_bind_reading: Remember the selected session on button {0}?
bind_failed: Could not remember the session on button {0}: {1}
phone_page: Panel is open on this page
browser_off_hint: Browser extension is not connected. Install the Tapswitch extension in your browser.
open_on_phone: Open the panel on your phone
step_camera: Point your phone camera at the QR code
step_bookmark: Bookmark the page or add it to the home screen
trouble_wifi: The phone and the computer must be on the same Wi-Fi network
trouble_firewall: Allow the program network access in the Windows Firewall prompt (private networks)
trouble_vpn: A VPN on the phone or the computer may block access to the home network
trouble_address: If the computer has several addresses, enter the right one under “Advanced”
panel_here_note: Buttons work with the mouse: click, double click, hold, drag; while this panel is open, the phone is disconnected
phone_panel_hint: Off — the panel is right on this page
confirm_bind_setting: Confirm before remembering on a button
autostart_hint: Without opening the page — tray icon only
restart_note: Port and address take effect after the program restarts
icon_project_hint: Works only in a process with roles from
gesture_menu: Right-click a panel button on this page to change its look (caption, color, icon), make it a key-combination button (e.g. Win+H — voice typing) or clear it
hotkey_prompt: Press a key or a combination
hotkey_hint: Pressing the panel button presses this combination in the active program, e.g. Win+H — Windows voice typing; the session remembered on the button is replaced
host_hint: The computer's address in the link and QR code; usually detected automatically, set it manually if the phone can't open the link and the computer has several networks (VPN, WSL or Hyper-V virtual adapters)
advanced_hint: Button profiles, port, phone address, log
gesture_tap_text: the button's app or session; on an empty button — remember where you worked last
gesture_hold_text: the current app or session (replaces the old one)
profiles_hint: Button profiles: click a preview to make it current; on the phone, swipe left or right
profiles_setting_hint: Six sets of buttons: swipe on the phone, buttons 1–6 and previews on the page; off — a single set as before
look_combo_removed: The combination will be removed when you save
look_icon_auto_hint: Session role or program icon, as now
look_icon_text_hint: 1–5 characters or an emoji, shown large, e.g. G, R, DSH, ⌘
look_reset_hint: Reset look: automatic caption and icon, no color
look_binding_reset_hint: Remove the key combination from the button — applied when you save
look_icon_lib_search: Search: save, cube, camera, render, undo…
look_img_drop: Drop an image here or paste it (Ctrl+V): PNG, JPG, SVG, ICO
look_app_none: No program windows are open — start the program or enter the path to its .exe
look_app_path: Path to .exe, e.g. C:\Program Files\Blender Foundation\Blender\blender.exe
